plugins.name: neo-dev-toolkit
plugins.description: Opinionated Claude Code toolkit: neo is a thin loop wrapper over the agent-skills SDLC (recursive goal → iterate against an exit condition → human gate), with an ingest memory primitive, GitLab/Atlassian connectors, API-doc tooling, and Go service scaffolding/migration — plus the upstream agent-skills lifecycle bundle (24 spec→ship skills, 4 specialist agents, 8 slash commands).
